Help TTS Server run in background, prevent being killed by system

Why Keep Alive?

Android automatically cleans up background apps to save battery. Manufacturers (Xiaomi, Huawei, OPPO, vivo, etc.) have additional restrictions that may kill TTS Server.

Recommended Setup

Basic users: Enable "Battery Whitelist" only
Need stability: Whitelist + Keep Alive Service
Maximum keep-alive: Enable multiple advanced options

Keep-Alive Options

Battery Whitelist
System feature to bypass battery optimization. Essential.

Keep Alive Service
Foreground service + wake lock. Recommended baseline.

Boot Auto Start
Automatically start service after device reboot.

Accessibility Keep Alive
Highest system priority, most stable. Requires manual permission.

Notification Keep Alive
Use notification listener service. Requires manual permission.

Alarm Keep Alive
Wake up every minute. Higher battery usage.

Network Keep Alive
Keep network connection active. Useful for forwarder.

Pixel Keep Alive
1-pixel window when screen off, auto-hides when on. Zero disturbance.

Notes

1. Keep-alive merges with forwarder notification when running
2. Some manufacturers need extra "Manufacturer Settings"
3. Multiple options increase battery usage
4. TTS engine mode does not occupy audio focus

string.name: systts_in_app_play_info_html
string.DATA:
打开此选项后，将直接使用本程序内置的音频播放器，而非转由系统TTS组件播放。
由于无需手动解码，且采样率也可在播放中变更，可解决多语音采样率不同时和部分设备的webm格式播放异常问题。

当然，直接播放也有兼容性问题：
- 由于并未将原始音频发送到系统TTS组件，所以如果调用TTS者是先缓存后播放机制，即并非由系统播放时，这将会导致缓存时音频为空和意外播放。
- raw格式依旧不支持，由系统播放。
- 性能方面相较系统播放略低。
- 由于内置播放器无音频缓冲，故段落与句子(如已启用分割长句)之间的间隔时间相较系统播放会多出几百毫秒的延迟。
